summary: Canadian Natural Resources filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026 announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of C$0.625 per common share, payable January 5, 2027 to holders of record December 15, 2026. The board declared the dividend following the March 2026 increase, marking the 26th consecutive annual raise with a 20% CAGR. No transaction, stake, premium or advisor is involved. Structure is an ordinary dividend declaration by a senior E&P; watch for ex-dividend date and payout sustainability rather than any arbitrage angle.
